title: Finite Galois neighbourhood representative of any geometric germ
statement: Let $K\subset K_s\subset\Omega$ be a compatible tower of fields [def-pc-field-extension], where $K_s$ is a separable closure of $K$ [def-kun-separably-closed] and $\Omega$ is algebraically closed and algebraic over $K$. Let $s=\operatorname{Spec}(K\to\Omega)$ be the canonical geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] and $F$ a sheaf of sets on the small etale site of $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Write $M$ for its geometric stalk at $s$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. For every finite intermediate field $L/K$ of $K_s/K$ and every $m\in M$, there exist a finite Galois intermediate field $E/K$ of $K_s/K$ containing $L$, its canonical lift $y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}E$ induced by the field inclusions, and $z\in F(\operatorname{Spec}E)$ whose germ at $y$ is $m$.

source.place: Tag 04JM (lemma-global-sections-point), direct proof; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04JM

proof.text: Joint surjectivity of the stalk injections gives a section representing the germ in a pointed etale neighbourhood. Its component containing the point is the spectrum of a finite separable field P/K, by the etale fibre theorem over K. Restrict the section to this component.

Factor the embedding of P into Omega through Ks, since separable elements lie in the embedded separable closure. Adjoin the conjugates of finite K-bases of P and L in Ks to obtain a finite Galois intermediate field E containing both. Pull back the section from Spec P to Spec E; the canonical inclusions specify the lift and naturality preserves its germ.

proof_origin.place: Tag 04JM, direct proof, specialized to the canonical lifts over L; second-reader formal reduction G3

theorem exists_finiteGalois_germ_representative
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K Ω]
    (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of K))
    (hs : s = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))
    (F : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (max (u + 1) v)))
    (L : IntermediateField K Ks) [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (m : (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj F) :
    ∃ E : FiniteGaloisIntermediateField K Ks,
      L ≤ E.toIntermediateField ∧
      ∃ y : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj (etaleSpec K E),
        y.left = Spec.map
          (CommRingCat.ofHom ((algebraMap Ks Ω).comp E.toIntermediateField.subtype)) ∧
        ∃ z : F.obj.obj (op (etaleSpec K E)),
          (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber (etaleSpec K E) y F.obj z = m
